comparisons.title: TurboTenant vs Avail: fees compared
comparisons.summary: Both have a $0 tier. TurboTenant's paid tier is a flat annual price; Avail's paid tier is per unit. Avail's free plan charges tenants $2.50 per bank transfer vs TurboTenant's $2 on its free plan.
points: Paid tier: TurboTenant Pro is $199/year for 1–10 units; Avail Unlimited Plus is $9/unit/month.
Bank transfers: TurboTenant free plan $2, Pro free; Avail free plan $2.50 (tenant-paid), Unlimited Plus $0.
Screening: TurboTenant $55 (free) / $45 (Pro), renter-paid; Avail varies by location.

comparisons.title: Baselane vs Stessa: fees compared
comparisons.summary: Both start free and both bank through Thread Bank. Baselane's paid tier is $20/month (annual); Stessa's paid tiers are $12 and $28/month (annual).
points: Paid tiers: Baselane Smart $20/month on an annual plan; Stessa Manage $12/month and Pro $28/month (annual).
Screening: Baselane from $24.99; Stessa via RentPrep $29–$49.
ACH rent: Baselane $2–$5 (waived for Baselane deposits); Stessa: check provider.

comparisons.title: RentRedi vs Innago: fees compared
comparisons.summary: Innago is free for landlords and earns from tenant fees. RentRedi charges the landlord a subscription ($12/month billed annually up to $29.95 month-to-month).
points: Landlord cost: RentRedi $12–$29.95/month depending on billing term; Innago $0.
Tenant ACH: Innago $2 (tenant-paid); RentRedi: check provider.
Screening: Innago $30–$35 applicant-paid by default; RentRedi $39.99 tenant-paid ($49.99 with income verification).
